page.overview:
Who is Stussy?

Stussy is MADS' first-ever successful clone, having been modeled after Miss Buckingham Stussy. She is a masked agent of CP0, although she is actually a spy employed by Dr. Vegapunk and spent years working deeply undercover in the World Government until she was forced to discard her cover, during which she was allegedly killed by another agent. Additionally, while acting as an agent, she operated as an emperor of the Underworld under the epithet "Queen of the Pleasure District".

Initially, she was a minor antagonist of the Egghead Arc, but later became a major ally to Vegapunk and the Straw Hat Pirates when her background and true allegiance were revealed.

Stussy appears younger than her actual age, with short curly blonde hair, blue eyes, red lipstick, and red-painted fingernails. She has a thin and slightly curved body with large breasts.

As an agent of CP0, she wears a uniform consisting of a ruffled-collared white dress with a pink necktie, white matching cape and gloves. She also dons fishnet stockings with fluffy rims and a garter belt. While on duty, she sometimes wears a mask in the form of a hood that covers her head, resembling a fox.
